case: ESRF Example #3 hybrid undulator, HCurl order-1 reduced-A first Picard matrix with Kelvin exterior
meshes: Cubit 2025.12 build_hybrid_undulator_mesh.py; iron/air/kelvin sizes 4/6/12 mm times mesh_size_scale
finding: In NGSolve 6.2.2606 this mesh family factored at 597k free DOF with measured L-factor NZE 1.66e9, failed with bad_array_new_length at 951k free DOF, and exited with access violation at 1.72M free DOF. L-factor NZE was not measured for either failure. Extrapolations of approximately 3.6e9 and 9.9e9 suggest a possible indexing or allocation limit, but do not establish its cause or a universal 2^31 threshold. The diagnostic alternative factorization was interrupted at 71 GB, so it does not prove successful factorization. PARDISO is not a fallback.
limit_status: Historical unmodified-runtime failure causes remain unproven. An isolated guarded 2607 build solved two smaller matrices and rejected the 950584-free-DOF matrix at its counter-range check. Standard runtime deployment and complete release validation remain pending; no universal DOF limit is established.

source_inspection_2607.finding: Allocate accumulates cnt and cnt_master in long int before assignment to size_t indices. Windows x64 long is 32-bit, so counts exceeding LONG_MAX cannot be represented by these intermediate counters.
source_inspection_2607.scope: static source finding; not a measured factor count or proof of the cause of the recorded runtime failures

consequence: the full-size reduced-A route uses the explicit solver='ams' (AMS-preconditioned CG with a true-residual check)

guarded_2607_validation.patch_behavior: Check both signed-long symbolic-entry accumulators against LONG_MAX before addition; release the ordering graph when construction throws. Does not widen indices or change numerical factorization.

rows.message: SparseCholesky symbolic storage exceeds the supported counter range; use an iterative solver

limitations: Isolated experimental library; not the standard released runtime.
First linear matrix only; not nonlinear ESRF acceptance.
Concurrent validation runtime numerical validation; no timing comparison.
The 950584-free-DOF case was rejected, not solved; its factor NZE was not measured.
Does not prevent every out-of-memory failure or prove the causes of prior unmodified-library crashes.
Full upstream regression suite and exact release-quad remain outstanding.
